limitations: Consensus is tested after spatial scoring rather than during source formation; NMF rank is fixed to the true two-source challenge and remains unconstrained by calcium kinetics; directional contrast uses maximum correlations and may cancel heterogeneous source asymmetries.

claim_impacts.scope: Six-seed targeted development package with disjoint artifact definitions, one-to-one weak-identity matching, and explicit forward and reversed kinetic gates.
claim_impacts.summary: The experiment supports this claim only within its registered scope.

gates.criterion: Every artifact referenced by the v1 experiment story is available and checksum identified at migration.
gates.observed: Captured 5 of 5 referenced artifacts with SHA-256 identities.

summary: Consensus and single-window stopping were identical at F1 0.568 and radius sensitivity 0.0417. Rank-two NMF reduced weak-identity recovery from 0.354 to 0.069 and mean F1 from 0.580 to 0.354. Directional contrast reduced reversed AUC to 0.523 but also reduced forward AUC to 0.477, failing useful directionality. Only one of five gates passed.
